title: RB1 Temporal Acceptance T11 Traceability Architecture-Invariant Audit
scope: Documentation, provenance and relation-to-test traceability only. No production source, reference data, scientific tolerance, physics, solver or performance policy change.

invariants.assessment: Single-kernel architecture unchanged; documentation only.
Kernel/I-O separation unchanged; no kernel or adapter source modified.
Explicit data separation preserved; H_budget remains numerical configuration.
Persistent state layout unchanged.
Worker scratch ownership unchanged.
Scalable internal layout and batching remain unchanged.
Transactional semantics are traced, not changed: rejection preserves committed state and rollback remains authoritative.
Warm-start and recomputation behavior unchanged; no state semantics modified.
Generic time is preserved; F-VQ34 uses non-calendar horizons and F-DOC08 introduces no calendar assumption.
Flexible coupling-window architecture unchanged; no coupling-window rule introduced.
Coupling remains first-class but is not broadened by this documentation unit.
Groundwater interface contract unchanged; no groundwater accuracy claim added.
Mass conservation remains absolute; hard mass rejection is explicitly traced as preceding temporal certificate acceptance.
Interface-sensitivity outputs unchanged.
Coupling-cost objective unchanged; no extra production solve is introduced.
MultiSWAP architecture unchanged.
No 1-to-1 MODFLOW mapping assumption introduced.
Optional deep-vadose composition remains outside SWAP and unchanged.
Mass-conserving component transitions unchanged.
Alternative soil-water solver openness preserved; the traced certificate remains explicitly Richards-scoped.
Physics reuse architecture unchanged.
No module gains dependency on HeadCalc internals.
Physics and numerical policy remain separate; H_budget is explicitly numerical configuration and no physics option changes.
Predictable-runtime policy unchanged; bounded retry is traced without adding a monotonicity assumption.
Reference mode remains available and is the scope of the traced Richards authority.
Runtime diagnostic contract is preserved; invalid native H_budget values remain diagnostically visible while certificate use fails closed.
Optional-functionality scaling unchanged.
Runtime/coupler composition ownership unchanged.
No silent dependencies added: no default H_budget, no calendar assumption, no no-history bootstrap and no implicit coupling context.
This explicit 30-invariant audit accompanies the traceability change and records no adverse architecture delta.

hard_nonclaims: No numeric H_budget is selected or recommended.
No universal temporal tolerance or groundwater-head accuracy budget is established.
No production source or reference data is changed.
No scientific tolerance, physics, solver or performance policy is changed.
No Status A or Status AA is established.
No T12 application-validation claim is made.
Surface-evaporation throughput/scaling remains outside this workunit.
